items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you know Big L. Louis? [INTERVIEWEE] Well. Mm-hmm.

ctx.x: Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Uh... Peter Bacar was playing violin.
Mm-hmm. Did you know Big L. Louis?

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Louis Armstrong's uniqueness and influence on other musicians ('There ain't no more Louie... lot of them right now, doing great trying to copy Louie'), but does not describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with Armstrong himself.
